description: This file is the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports React, ReactDOM, styles, and the main App component, then renders the App inside the DOM element with id 'root' within a React.StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree.

methods.name: root.render
